svg.title: Drawing 01 — Existing plan — Pollokshields Tenement Reordering
svg.desc: Existing plan of a c.1900 tenement flat: generous front living room with bay and front bedroom, a hall in two legs from the landing, a small rear kitchen with box room and press, a bathroom and a back room with a WC and press strip between it and the hall.
svg.text: Common and shared walls indicated by position
Pollokshields Tenement Reordering · Staging drawing set
